description: This file provides helper functions related to gateway discovery, including resolving service hosts, generating service endpoints, SSH targets, and URLs for gateways discovered via the GatewayDiscoveryModel. It encapsulates logic for parsing and validating gateway-related information.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(for:)
methods.description: Resolves the service host for a discovered gateway, returning a trimmed string or nil if invalid.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(_:)
methods.description: Returns a trimmed and non-empty host string or nil.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(for:)
methods.description: Provides the host and port tuple for a given gateway if valid.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(serviceHost:servicePort:)
methods.description: Constructs a host and port tuple from optional host and port inputs, validating port range.

methods.name: sshTarget(for:)
methods.description: Generates SSH target string for a gateway, including port if not default.

methods.name: directUrl(for:)
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket URL (ws or wss) for the given gateway.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl(serviceHost:servicePort:)
methods.description: Generates a secure (wss) or insecure (ws) URL based on host type and port.
